text: Among other things there was a superb god Buddha in a splendid shrine. "Someone in the family MUST have been in India," Sara thought. "They have got used to Indian things and like them. I shall feel as if they were friends, even if a head never looks out of the attic window." When she was taking in the evening's milk for the cook (there was really no odd job she was not called upon to do), she saw something occur which made the situation more interesting than ever.
